bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage=deploy/state/help-rich-manual-20261123
test -s "$stage/checkpoint.json"
test -s "$stage/build-checkpoint.json"
test ! -e deploy/state/help-rich-manual-live-20261123.json
old_sha="$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("deploy/state/help-rich-manual-20261123/checkpoint.json"))["old_sha"])')"
new_sha="$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("deploy/state/help-rich-manual-20261123/checkpoint.json"))["new_sha"])')"
old_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-help-rich-manual-20261123)"
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:help-rich-manual-20261123)"
test "$old_image" != "$new_image"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs|cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$old_sha"
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs-target-only.mjs"|cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
rollback(){ docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-help-rich-manual-20261123 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local; docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true; }
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:help-rich-manual-20261123 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null;then rollback;exit 70;fi
sleep 5
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != "$new_image" ||
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != true ||
 test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$new_sha" ||
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Restarting}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != false ||
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" != active ||
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" != true;then rollback;exit 71;fi
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /app/gaybbs.mjs)" = "1000:1000:600" || { rollback;exit 72; }
if ! docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("/app/gaybbs.mjs","utf8");const a=s.indexOf("function registerOperationHelpHandlers(");const b=s.indexOf("// src/",a+8);const x=s.slice(a,b<0?s.length:b);if(!s.includes("STARTLESS_REPEATED_START_LINK_FORBIDDEN")||!x.includes("startCompactProfileEditor")||!s.includes("HTML"))process.exit(77);';then rollback;exit 73;fi
printf '{"state":"VERIFIED","old_image":"%s","new_image":"%s","old_sha":"%s","new_sha":"%s","source_pr":73,"scope":"operationHelpHandlers only"}\n' "$old_image" "$new_image" "$old_sha" "$new_sha" > deploy/state/help-rich-manual-live-20261123.json
echo GAYBBS_RICH_HELP_LIVE_DEPLOY_AND_ROLLBACK_GUARD=PASS
